description: Alawwa Pradeshiya Sabha - The list of the Road and Throughfares Owned by the Alawwa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification deals specifically with land and property matters - the determination of ownership of roads and thoroughfares by the Pradeshiya Sabha Alawwa local government authority. It involves legal confirmation of property ownership, references to land surveys with coordinates, and establishes which roads are deemed to be owned by the local government body. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land ownership and property rights rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
